title: Network access is denied to student code
description:
As the maintainer, I want student programs unable to open sockets, so that they cannot reach the internet.

Feature: Network denial
  Scenario: Python cannot connect out
    Given a Python program that connects to example.com on port 80
    When the project is run
    Then the program fails with a permission error
  Scenario: C cannot connect out
    Given a C program that calls connect() to a public address
    When the project is run
    Then connect() returns EPERM
right_now_summary: Student programs must be blocked from making network connections.
